body:
Add the clean-room `.cps` snippet library and user custom snippets to the Post Editor.

**Layout design implemented:** Design A (Snippet library tab in the compact bottom-right drawer) and Design B (Snippet library left sidebar). See the layout sketches on #2050.

## Scope

1. Create clean-room built-in JS snippets in `crates/post` or `crates/app` using RS-274 / ISO 6983 standards and this repo's `PRELUDE` API (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md`):
   - Program start and end (`onOpen`, `onClose`, unit and safety blocks, retract, end of program).
   - Tool change (`onToolChange`, `T.. M6`, `G43 H..`).
   - Spindle and coolant (`onSpindleSpeed`, `machine.spindleMax` guard, `machine.coolants` lookup).
   - Linear and arc moves (`onRapid`, `onLinear`, `onCircular` with `OriginX/Y/Z` subtraction).
   - Canned cycles (`onCycle`, `onCyclePoint`, `onCycleEnd` with `G80`).
   - Work offset (`WorkOffset` parameter and origin helper).
   - Sequence numbers (`N10`, `N20` helper).
   - Option declaration block (ready for `#2049`).
2. Add user snippet persistence under `<user_posts>/snippets/*.json` (`{ id, name, category, description, code }`) using atomic temp-file writes and plain-filename validation.
3. Build the Snippet library UI (`Snippet library` sidebar in Design B, `Snippet library` tab in Design A) with search filter, category groups, `Insert at cursor` using `TextEditState::cursor`, `Save selection as snippet`, and user-snippet delete.

## Rules

- Clean-room only: write every snippet from public RS-274 / ISO 6983 docs and our own scripts (`assets/posts/mazak.cps`, `grblhal.cps`).
- Safety floor (`AGENTS.md`): verify snippet G-code output with automated tests.

## Done means

- Tests combine the built-in snippets against the preview sample streams and verify that each compiles and outputs valid RS-274 / ISO 6983 blocks.
- Tests verify creating, reading, updating, and deleting custom snippet files in a temp `CAMCRAFT_POSTS/snippets` folder.
- Structural UI tests (`egui_kittest`) verify filtering snippets, inserting a snippet at the editor cursor, and saving selected text as a user snippet.

Part of #2050
